subject.title: Remote skill bin probe times out when node is co-located with gateway (macOS app as node on same host)

question: Should automatic remote skill bin probing for macOS app-backed nodes be delayed/backed off, skipped only for proven co-located app nodes, or disabled by default for app nodes?
rationale: The current app now implements `system.which` and can legitimately support remote exec, so the remaining fix crosses product behavior, compatibility, and readiness policy rather than being a purely mechanical source patch.

options.title: Defer And Back Off Probes
options.body: Keep remote macOS skills supported while delaying initial app-node probing until readiness is stronger and applying bounded retry/backoff after failed probes.

options.title: Skip Co-located App Nodes
options.body: Avoid probing loopback or same-host app nodes that add no remote skill value, while preserving probing for real remote app nodes.

options.title: Disable App-node Probing By Default
options.body: Stop automatic app-node remote skill eligibility unless explicitly enabled, reducing warning noise at the cost of default remote skill support.

recommendation.title: Defer And Back Off Probes
recommendation.body: Keep remote macOS skills supported while delaying initial app-node probing until readiness is stronger and applying bounded retry/backoff after failed probes.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal spans remote skills, node command policy, and macOS node execution compatibility.
